action_items: MINOR: Fix regex pattern to avoid detecting chord symbols within words (e.g., 'Amazing' should not become '2mazing'). Consider using negative lookbehind/lookahead or context-aware filtering.
critical_code_review_comments: The chord regex pattern in server.py line 834 uses \b at the start but not at the end, which helps capture sharps/flats but also causes false positives within words. Consider adding word boundary checks or filtering out matches that are part of larger words.
